blocks.html: Robinsons Place Antipolo will be the new home of Mercato, east of Metro Manila. Known to be the premier destination lifestyle food market in the Philippines, Mercato will bring 30 food entrepreneurs who will be showcasing their wide range of great and tasty preparations dubbed as “Gourmet Food Fair” which will run until the end of 2022.

The food show offers a wide range to choose from desserts, savory meals, to fastfood and kiddie favorites. “We are inviting shoppers to sample these treats: Oreo Ice Cream, Korean faves like corndog and fried noodles, all-time favorites like pizza, pasta, rice meals and so much more,” enthuses Ms. Tina Real-Lim, assistant Vice president for Lease, Robinsons Malls. Ms. Real – Lim adds that Robinsons Malls strong supports MSMEs and recognizes there growth potentials.

Robinsons Place Antipolo provides a picture-perfect backdrop for Mercato to showcase their wide selection and help them promote their businesses. On the onset, we have noticed that our shoppers are doing a lot of take-outs or bring their food purchases to the Picnic Grounds of the mall where they enjoy the cool breeze of the City, outdoor activities for kids &bonding moments with their family and friends,” says Myron Yao, Robinsons Malls Operations Director for Robinsons Malls.

After enjoying sumptuous meals at the Picnic Grounds, customers can even learn a new hobby as bicycles and e-scooters will be available for rental; plus RC race tracks will be installed so that enthusiasts can enjoy playing at the malls’ spacious open grounds.
Robinsons Place Antipolo’s Gourmet Food Fair runs Thursdays to Sundays, 3 pm to 10 pm at the Mall’s Upper Ground Parking Area.
